transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom Corporate Support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hello Alex. My name is Mark Taylor, calling on behalf of Nova Retail Group. I need to get some information for porting our numbers to a new carrier.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, Mark, I can certainly assist you with that. To access the account, I'll first need to verify your credentials for security purposes. Could you please provide me with your Cymbal Telecom Customer ID?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, of course. The customer ID is CUST-2007.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. That's C-U-S-T, hyphen, two-zero-zero-seven. And could you also provide the six-digit security PIN associated with the account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Let me see... yes, the PIN should be 5-0-7-4-9-8.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Please allow me just a moment while I pull up your account information.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Take your time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience, Mark. I've successfully verified the account for Nova Retail Group. I see you have 25 active mobile lines with us. So, you mentioned you need information for porting out?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's correct. I need our main account number and the port-out PIN that our new provider is asking for.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can definitely provide that for you. Before I proceed, and just for our own internal feedback, may I ask if there was a specific reason for your decision to switch providers? We value your business and any feedback you can share.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, no, it's not a service issue at all. Your service has been very reliable for us. This is purely a corporate-level decision. Our parent company signed a new national agreement, and we're required to consolidate all of our telecom vendors.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I see. Thank you for sharing that, Mark. I completely understand how those corporate directives work. We're sorry to see you go, but I'm happy to make this transition as smooth as possible for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I appreciate that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright. So, first, let's get you that account number. Do you have a pen and paper ready?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I'm ready. Go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your Cymbal Telecom account number is 9-5-5-8-2-0-1-3-3-4-7.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: For verification, could you please read that back to me one more time?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is correct. Thank you, Mark. Now, regarding the port-out PIN. For your account's security, I will need to generate a new, temporary PIN specifically for this purpose. It will be different from your account's security PIN.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that makes sense. That's fine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: This process will just take a moment. Please stay on the line.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding. I have successfully generated the temporary Number Transfer PIN for your account.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great. I'm ready.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The PIN is a six-digit number. It is 7-3-8-9-0-2.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, let me write that down... 7-3-8-9-0-2.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct. Again, that is seven, three, eight, nine, zero, two.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Got it. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. Now, it's very important to note that this Number Transfer PIN will expire in exactly seven calendar days for security reasons. You'll need to provide both the account number and this PIN to your new carrier to initiate the porting of all 25 lines.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Seven days. Okay, that should be plenty of time. And this PIN is good for all the lines on the account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct. This one PIN authorizes the transfer of any or all of the 25 mobile numbers currently under the Nova Retail Group account.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Perfect. And how long does the porting process usually take once we initiate it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The porting process itself is typically completed within 24 to 48 hours from when your new provider submits the request. During that time, your service with Cymbal Telecom will remain active to prevent any interruption.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that's good to know. We definitely want to avoid any downtime for our employees.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. The system is designed for a seamless transition. Your numbers will remain active on our network until the moment they are activated on the new carrier's network.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's great. One more question, regarding our final bill. How will that be handled?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: An excellent question. Your billing cycle with us ends on the 28th of each month. Once the very last of your 25 numbers is successfully ported out, your account will be scheduled for closure.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Scheduled for closure? So it doesn't close immediately?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct. It will remain technically active until the end of your current billing cycle. You will then receive one final invoice from Cymbal Telecom.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And will that final bill be for the full month?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, it will not. The final bill will be pro-rated. You will only be charged for the days in the cycle that your service was active with us, up to the day the final line was transferred.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Ah, okay. So if we port out on, say, the 15th of the month, we're only billed up to the 15th?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Precisely. The system automatically calculates the pro-rated amount based on the port-out completion date of the last line.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's very clear. Thank you for explaining that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. We want to ensure everything is transparent. That final invoice will be sent to the email address on file, which I see is mark.taylor@novaretailgroup.com. Is that still correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's my email. That is correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. And I see you're set up for automatic debit. The final pro-rated amount will be charged to the payment method on file as usual.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that works.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to be thorough, I've added detailed notes to your account documenting our conversation today, including the account number and the temporary PIN that was provided.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you, Alex. You've been extremely helpful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's my pleasure, Mark. I'm glad I could make this part of your transition a bit easier. Do you have any other questions for me at all? Anything else I can assist with regarding your Cymbal Telecom account today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, I think that covers everything. I have the account number, the port-out PIN, and a clear understanding of the final billing process. That's all I needed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. I'll also send a follow-up email to you shortly, just summarizing the key details we discussed, including the 7-day expiration of the PIN, for your records.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, that would be great. Thank you very much.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are most welcome. Is there anything else at all?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Nope, that's it for me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright then. Well, on behalf of everyone here at Cymbal Telecom, I want to thank you and Nova Retail Group for your business over the years. We were proud to serve you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you, Alex. We appreciated the service.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We wish you the very best with your new provider. Thank you for your call today, Mark.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Have a good day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You as well. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Goodbye.
